# run-dev-graph-sync

## Purpose & Output Contract

- 入力: C24/C11 検証済み local graph/config、last-synced snapshot、binding 別 remote state、任意の dry-run/confirmation。
- 出力: 3-way imports/exports/conflicts/tombstones/pending-retry plan、binding 別 linkage、更新済み snapshot receipt。
- 完了条件: binding ごとの mutation authority が一意で、同一状態の2回目 changes=0、done は default-branch merge evidence 満足時にだけ反映される。

local graph が正本。`tracker_binding=beads` は C28 の status/depends_on exact-set parity と push-only viewer mirror、`github` は C12 の Issue/Projects、`none` は external write なし。authority の混在は拒否する。

## Protocol

1. schema と repo config を検証し、last-synced snapshot を base に 3-way plan を作る。
2. beads は `bd-bridge.py` だけを使う。GitHub mutation を併用しない。github は `gh-bridge.py --dry-run` preview 後だけ apply する。
3. Issue は id+updated_at、Project field は field value updatedAt を conflict hint とする。双方変更は自動上書きせず manual conflict。同時刻は GitHub を表示値に採用し local confirmation flag を残す。Status は local→Project 一方向で、remote Status を done authority にしない。
4. close/delete は node 物理削除でなく tombstone/status transition。部分的な Project failure は local promotion を戻さず alias 単位 `pending_retry`。
5. C26 で default-branch merge evidence と C27 pending event を reconcile する。closed-unmerged、dirty/feature worktree、policy/evidence 不足は done にしない。

同一 state の二回目は changes=0。`--dry-run` はlocal/external write 0。apply後は同じ入力でもう一度dry-runし、`imports=exports=pending_retry=0`まで繰り返す。report は imports/exports/conflicts/tombstones/pending_retry/project snapshots を返す。

実行可能な同期本体は`../../scripts/sync-graph.py`である。通常はbridgeからremote stateを収集し、決定論的試験ではrepository内の`--remote-state` fixture adapterを使う。dry-run/apply/検証dry-runを同じgraph・snapshot・remote入力で行う。

```bash
python3 ../../scripts/sync-graph.py --repo-root "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT" --dry-run
python3 ../../scripts/sync-graph.py --repo-root "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT" --apply \
  --parity-manifest "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/dev-graph/run-dev-graph-schedule/parity-manifest.json"
python3 ../../scripts/sync-graph.py --repo-root "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT" --dry-run
```

`--parity-manifest`を渡した`--apply`は、収束後のgraphから`build-parity-manifest.py`でC28 parity manifestを作り直す (execution-tracker-contract §10 が C03 に課す回復手順)。C28が`parity_manifest_missing`を報告した場合の対処もこれで、`source_graph_digest`だけを現在値へ書き換える修正はstale検出を恒久的に無効化するため禁止する。生成が失敗したら`pending_retry`へ載せ`ok=false`とし、last-synced snapshotを進めない。「同期は成功したがready-setは空のまま」を作らないための停止であり、次回syncで同じ差分から再試行する。sync全体を回さずmanifestだけ作り直す場合は、read-onlyな単独generatorを直接呼ぶ。`--out`は`--repo-root`基準で解決するため、C03が書きC16が読む同一pathを両skillで同じ表記に保つ。

```bash
python3 ../../scripts/build-parity-manifest.py --repo-root "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT" \
  --out "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/dev-graph/run-dev-graph-schedule/parity-manifest.json"
```

Beads dependencyは`dep-add`/`dep-remove`でexact-setへ収束する。GitHub Projectsはfield valueの`updatedAt`とlast-synced snapshotで3-way判定し、aliasごとにitemを1件だけ保持する。permission/rate-limit/field削除/option renameはlocal nodeをrollbackせず、該当linkageを`pending_retry`にする。PR lifecycleは全linked PRを列挙し、configの`required_pull_requests=all|any`を満たすまでdone requestを作らない。Beads linkageはexact markerまたは同番号`gh:pr` gateのどちらかを要求する。

    86→    for item in raw:

    90→            if relation not in (None, "blocks"):

   126→    gh_bridge: Path,
   127→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   128→    remote: dict[str, Any] = {"schema_version": "1.0", "beads": {}, "github": {}}

   130→        str((node.get("beads_linkage") or {}).get("bd_issue_id")): _node_id(node)
   131→        for node in nodes if (node.get("beads_linkage") or {}).get("bd_issue_id")
   132→    }
   133→    for node in nodes:
   134→        node_id = _node_id(node)
   135→        binding = node.get("tracker_binding")
   136→        if binding == "beads":
   137→            issue_id = (node.get("beads_linkage") or {}).get("bd_issue_id")
   138→            if not issue_id:
   139→                continue
   140→            receipt = _invoke(
   141→                [sys.executable, str(bd_bridge), "--repo-root", str(root), "--op", "show", "--bd-issue-id", str(issue_id)],
   142→                root,

   153→        elif binding == "github":
   154→            linkage = node.get("issue_linkage") or {}
   155→            repo, number = linkage.get("repo"), linkage.get("issue_number")
   156→            if not repo or not number:
   157→                continue

   159→                [sys.executable, str(gh_bridge), "--op", "issue-fetch", "--repo", str(repo), "--number", str(number)],
   160→                root,
   161→                f"GitHub Issue read {node_id}",
   162→            )
   163→            issue = receipt.get("result") or {}
   164→            projects: dict[str, Any] = {}
   165→            for project in node.get("github_project_linkages") or []:
   166→                alias, project_id, item_id = project.get("project_alias"), project.get("project_id"), project.get("item_id")
   167→                if not alias or not project_id or not issue.get("id"):
   168→                    continue

   170→                owner = project.get("owner_login")
   171→                number_value = project.get("project_number")
   172→                if owner and number_value:
   173→                    resolved = _invoke(
   174→                        [
   175→                            sys.executable, str(gh_bridge), "--op", "project-resolve",
   176→                            "--owner", str(owner), "--project-number", str(number_value),
   177→                        ],
   178→                        root,
   179→                        f"GitHub Project definition {node_id}/{alias}",
   180→                    )
   181→                    for field in (resolved.get("result") or {}).get("fields", {}).get("nodes", []):
   182→                        if isinstance(field, dict) and field.get("name"):
   183→                            definitions[str(field["name"])] = field
   184→                found = _invoke(
   185→                    [
   186→                        sys.executable, str(gh_bridge), "--op", "project-item-find",
   187→                        "--project-id", str(project_id), "--content-id", str(issue["id"]),
   188→                    ],
   189→                    root,
   190→                    f"GitHub Project read {node_id}/{alias}",
   191→                )
   192→                items = (found.get("result") or {}).get("items", [])
   193→                if len(items) > 1:
   194→                    raise ContractError(f"duplicate Project items for {node_id}/{alias}")
   195→                matching = items
   196→                projects[str(alias)] = {
   197→                    "item_id": matching[0].get("id") if matching else None,
   198→                    "updated_at": matching[0].get("updatedAt") if matching else None,
   199→                    "fields": _field_values(matching[0]) if matching else {},
   200→                    "definitions": definitions,
   201→                }
   202→            remote["github"][node_id] = {**issue, "repo": repo, "projects": projects}
   203→    return remote

   218→def _status_from_remote(binding: str, remote: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   219→    if remote.get("deleted") is True:
   220→        return "tombstoned"
   221→    raw = str(remote.get("state") if binding == "github" else remote.get("status") or "").casefold()
   222→    if raw in {"closed", "done"}:
   223→        return "closed"
   224→    if raw in {"blocked"}:
   225→        return "blocked"
   226→    return "active"

   229→def _status_to_remote(binding: str, status: str) -> str:
   230→    if binding == "github":
   231→        return "closed" if status in {"done", "closed", "tombstoned"} else "open"
   232→    return {"done": "closed", "closed": "closed", "tombstoned": "closed", "blocked": "blocked"}.get(status, "open")

   235→def _choose(
   236→    *,
   237→    node_id: str,
   238→    field: str,
   239→    local: Any,
   240→    remote: Any,
   241→    base: dict[str, Any] | None,
   242→    local_updated: Any,
   243→    remote_updated: Any,
   244→    confirmation: str | None,
   245→) -> str:
   246→    if local == remote:
   247→        return "equal"
   248→    if base is None:
   249→        local_changed = remote_changed = True
   250→    else:
   251→        local_changed = local != base.get("local")
   252→        remote_changed = remote != base.get("remote")
   253→        if not local_changed and not remote_changed:
   254→            return "equal"
   255→        if local_changed and not remote_changed:
   256→            return "local"
   257→        if remote_changed and not local_changed:
   258→            return "remote"
   259→        if not local_changed and not remote_changed:
   260→            return "equal"
   261→    if confirmation in {"local", "remote"}:
   262→        return confirmation
   263→    local_time, remote_time = _time(local_updated), _time(remote_updated)
   264→    if local_time and remote_time and local_time != remote_time:
   265→        return "local" if local_time > remote_time else "remote"
   266→    if base is None and local_time and not remote_time:
   267→        return "local"
   268→    if base is None and remote_time and not local_time:
   269→        return "remote"
   270→    return "conflict"

   274→    projects = ((config.get("github") or {}).get("projects", [])) if isinstance(config, dict) else []

   281→def _confirmations(values: list[str]) -> dict[tuple[str, str], str]:
   282→    result: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
   283→    for value in values:
   284→        try:
   285→            identity, choice = value.rsplit("=", 1)
   286→            node_id, field = identity.split(":", 1)
   287→        except ValueError as exc:
   288→            raise ContractError("--confirm must be NODE:FIELD=local|remote") from exc
   289→        if choice not in {"local", "remote"} or not node_id or not field:
   290→            raise ContractError("--confirm must be NODE:FIELD=local|remote")
   291→        result[(node_id, field)] = choice
   292→    return result

   295→def _plan(
   296→    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]],
   297→    remote: dict[str, Any],
   298→    snapshot: dict[str, Any],
   299→    config: dict[str, Any],
   300→    confirmations: dict[tuple[str, str], str],
   301→) -> dict[str, Any]:
   302→    imports: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   303→    exports: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   304→    conflicts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   305→    tombstones: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   306→    pending: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   307→    patches: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
   308→    next_snapshot: dict[str, Any] = {
   309→        "schema_version": "1.0",
   310→        "nodes": {},
   311→        "updated_at": snapshot.get("updated_at") or utc_now(),
   312→    }
   313→    base_nodes = snapshot.get("nodes", {}) if isinstance(snapshot, dict) else {}
   314→    projects = _config_projects(config)
   315→    beads_issue_by_graph = {
   316→        _node_id(item): (item.get("beads_linkage") or {}).get("bd_issue_id")
   317→        for item in nodes
   318→    }
   319→
   320→    for node in nodes:
   321→        node_id = _node_id(node)
   322→        binding = node.get("tracker_binding")
   323→        if binding == "none":
   324→            continue
   325→        if binding not in {"beads", "github"}:
   326→            raise ContractError(f"{node_id}: unresolved tracker_binding {binding!r}")
   327→        remote_node = _remote_map(remote, binding).get(node_id)
   328→        if remote_node is None:
   329→            linkage = node.get("beads_linkage") if binding == "beads" else node.get("issue_linkage")
   330→            if linkage:
   331→                target = "tombstoned" if binding == "github" else "closed"
   332→                if node.get("status") != target:
   333→                    patches.setdefault(node_id, {})["status"] = target
   334→                    imports.append({"node": node_id, "field": "status", "from": "missing", "to": target})
   335→                    tombstones.append({"node": node_id, "binding": binding, "status": target, "physical_delete": False})
   336→            else:
   337→                pending.append({"node": node_id, "binding": binding, "reason": "external_linkage_missing"})
   338→            continue
   339→        if not isinstance(remote_node, dict):
   340→            raise ContractError(f"{binding} remote node {node_id} must be an object")
   341→        base_node = base_nodes.get(node_id, {}) if isinstance(base_nodes, dict) else {}
   342→        issue_base = base_node.get("issue", {}) if isinstance(base_node, dict) else {}
   343→        local_updated, remote_updated = node.get("updated_at"), remote_node.get("updated_at")
   344→        local_values = {
   345→            "title": node.get("title"),
   346→            "status": _status_to_remote(binding, str(node.get("status"))),
   347→        }
   348→        remote_values = {
   349→            "title": remote_node.get("title"),
   350→            "status": _status_to_remote(binding, _status_from_remote(binding, remote_node)),
   351→        }
   352→        if binding == "github" and remote_node.get("deleted") is True:
   353→            local_values = {"status": local_values["status"]}
   354→            remote_values = {"status": remote_values["status"]}
   355→        if binding == "beads":
   356→            local_values["depends_on"] = sorted(node.get("depends_on", []))
   357→            remote_values["depends_on"] = sorted(remote_node.get("depends_on", []))
   358→        next_issue: dict[str, Any] = {}
   359→        for field in local_values:
   360→            local_value, remote_value = local_values[field], remote_values[field]
   361→            if field == "status" and remote_node.get("deleted") is True:
   362→                choice = "remote"
   363→            else:
   364→                choice = _choose(
   365→                    node_id=node_id,
   366→                    field=field,
   367→                    local=local_value,
   368→                    remote=remote_value,
   369→                    base=issue_base.get(field) if isinstance(issue_base, dict) else None,
   370→                    local_updated=local_updated,
   371→                    remote_updated=remote_updated,
   372→                    confirmation=confirmations.get((node_id, field)),
   373→                )
   374→            if choice == "conflict":
   375→                conflicts.append({
   376→                    "node": node_id, "field": field, "local": local_value, "remote": remote_value,
   377→                    "resolution": "manual", "display_value": remote_value,
   378→                    "confirmation_required": True,

   380→                next_issue[field] = issue_base.get(field, {"local": local_value, "remote": remote_value})

   383→                if node.get(field) != target:

   387→                    imports.append(record)

   396→                            continue
   397→                        exports.append({
   398→                            "node": node_id, "binding": binding, "kind": "dep-add",
   399→                            "dependency": dependency,
   400→                            "dependency_issue_id": beads_issue_by_graph[dependency],
   401→                        })

   406→                        exports.append({
   407→                            "node": node_id, "binding": binding, "kind": "dep-remove",
   408→                            "dependency": dependency,
   409→                            "dependency_issue_id": beads_issue_by_graph[dependency],
   410→                        })
   411→                else:
   412→                    exports.append({
   413→                        "node": node_id, "binding": binding, "kind": f"{field}-update",
   414→                        "field": field, "value": local_value,
   415→                    })
   416→                next_issue[field] = {"local": local_value, "remote": local_value}
   417→            else:
   418→                next_issue[field] = {"local": local_value, "remote": remote_value}
   419→
   420→        next_projects: dict[str, Any] = {}
   421→        if binding == "github" and remote_node.get("deleted") is not True:
   422→            remote_projects = remote_node.get("projects", {})
   423→            if not isinstance(remote_projects, dict):
   424→                raise ContractError(f"{node_id}: remote projects must be an object")

   427→                if alias not in projects:

   438→                if not linkage.get("item_id") and remote_project.get("item_id"):

   443→                    )
   444→                    adopted = next(

   458→                if not remote_project.get("item_id"):

   463→                base_project = ((base_node.get("projects") or {}).get(alias, {})) if isinstance(base_node, dict) else {}
   464→                next_fields: dict[str, Any] = {}
   465→                mappings = projects[alias].get("field_mappings", [])
   466→                remote_fields = remote_project.get("fields", {})

   482→                    remote_field = remote_fields.get(project_field, {"value": None, "updated_at": None})

1→"""bd-bridge の external_ref 冪等検索 (issue sys-docs-recompose-followups-20260718 finding 4) の回帰テスト。
     2→
     3→2026-07-18 の projection 再実行で二重起票が起きた機序:
     4→  bd 1.1.0 の `bd search --external-contains <ref> --json` は positional query を欠くと
     5→  JSON 行ではなくヘルプ文を stdout へ出す。`bd()` はそれを JSON として解せず
     6→  {"text": ..., "returncode": ...} に退避するため、_find_external からは「既存なし」に化け、
     7→  _create_one が毎回 create を打っていた (hub-foundation 0e9 系 / auth-tenancy p4q 系が同根)。
     8→
     9→既存の test_c27_c28_projection_contract.py の fake_bd は `search` が external_ref で
    10→一致する理想実装なので、この退行を構造的に検出できない。本ファイルは bd 1.1.0 の
    11→実挙動 (search は title/ID しか引かない・引数次第でヘルプ文を返す) を忠実に模し、
    12→list --status all フォールバックと show 再取得が load-bearing であることを固定する。
    13→"""
    14→from __future__ import annotations
    15→
    16→import importlib.util
    17→import sys
    18→from pathlib import Path
    19→
    20→import pytest
    21→
    22→PLUGIN = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    23→SCRIPTS = PLUGIN / "scripts"
    24→if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
    25→    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
    26→
    27→NODE = "T07-projection-node"
    28→DIGEST = "sha256:" + "c" * 64
    29→
    30→# bd() が JSON パースに失敗したときに返す形。bd 1.1.0 のヘルプ文出力を再現する。
    31→BD_110_SEARCH_HELP = {
    32→    "text": "Search issues across title and ID (excludes closed issues by default).",
    33→    "returncode": 0,
    34→}
    35→# bd list --json の行は external_ref を持つが issue_type/parent は持たない (実測 2026-07-20)。
    36→LIST_ROW = {"id": "HarnessHub-B42", "title": "projected", "status": "open", "external_ref": f"dev-graph:{NODE}"}
    37→
    38→
    39→def load(path: Path, name: str):
    40→    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    41→    assert spec and spec.loader
    42→    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    43→    sys.modules[name] = module
    44→    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    45→    return module
    46→
    47→
    48→@pytest.fixture
    49→def module():
    50→    return load(SCRIPTS / "bd-bridge.py", "bd_bridge_external_ref")
    51→
    52→
    53→def wire(module, monkeypatch, *, search, listed, detail=None, created=None):
    54→    """bd 1.1.0 を模した fake を注入し、実際に流れた argv を返す。"""
    55→    calls: list[list[str]] = []
    56→
    57→    def fake_bd(args, cwd, check=True):
    58→        calls.append(list(args))
    59→        if args[0] == "search":
    60→            return search
    61→        if args[0] == "list":
    62→            return listed
    63→        if args[0] == "show":
    64→            return detail
    65→        if args[0] == "update":
    66→            return detail
    67→        if args[0] == "create":
    68→            return created if created is not None else {"id": "HarnessHub-NEW"}
    69→        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected bd call: {args}")
    70→
    71→    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "bd", fake_bd)
    72→    return calls
    73→
    74→
    75→@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    76→    ("blind_search", "label"),
    77→    [([], "search miss"), (BD_110_SEARCH_HELP, "search help text")],
    78→)
    79→def test_find_external_recovers_via_list_when_search_is_blind(module, monkeypatch, tmp_path, blind_search, label):
    80→    """search が空でもヘルプ文でも、list --status all フォールバックが既存を必ず発見する。"""
    81→    calls = wire(module, monkeypatch, search=blind_search, listed=[LIST_ROW])
    82→    found = module._find_external(tmp_path, NODE)
    83→    assert found is not None and found["id"] == LIST_ROW["id"], label
    84→    fallback = next(args for args in calls if args[0] == "list")
    85→    assert fallback[fallback.index("--status") + 1] == "all"
    86→    # ヘルプ文を誘発する no-query 呼び出しへ退行していないこと。
    87→    assert not any("--external-contains" in args for args in calls)
    88→    assert calls[0][:2] == ["search", NODE]
    89→
    90→
    91→def test_find_external_short_circuits_when_search_hits(module, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    92→    """search が当たれば list --limit 10000 を引かない。
    93→
    94→    フォールバックだけを検査すると、search 呼び出しを消して常に全件 list する実装へ
    95→    退化しても全テストが緑のまま通る。高速経路が生きていることを別途固定する。
    96→    """
    97→    calls = wire(module, monkeypatch, search=[LIST_ROW], listed=[])
    98→    assert module._find_external(tmp_path, NODE)["id"] == LIST_ROW["id"]
    99→    assert [args[0] for args in calls] == ["search"]

   101→
   102→def test_find_external_requires_exact_external_ref_match(module, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
   103→    """部分一致 (前方/後方) を既存扱いすると別ノードへ誤って冪等化するため、完全一致のみ採る。"""
   104→    near = [
   105→        {**LIST_ROW, "id": "HarnessHub-B43", "external_ref": f"dev-graph:{NODE}-legacy"},
   106→        {**LIST_ROW, "id": "HarnessHub-B44", "external_ref": f"dev-graph:legacy-{NODE}"},
   107→    ]
   108→    wire(module, monkeypatch, search=near, listed=near)
   109→    assert module._find_external(tmp_path, NODE) is None
   110→
   111→
   112→def test_create_one_reuses_list_discovered_issue_instead_of_double_creating(module, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
   113→    """finding 4 の核: search が盲目でも create を打たず idempotent を返す (二重起票の回帰ガード)。"""
   114→    detail = {

   117→        "parent": "HarnessHub-EPIC",
   118→        "metadata": {"dev_graph_source_digest": DIGEST},

   121→    result = module._create_one(
   122→        tmp_path,
   123→        graph_node_id=NODE,
   124→        title="projected",
   125→        description="body",
   126→        issue_type="task",
   127→        parent="HarnessHub-EPIC",
   128→        source_digest=DIGEST,
   129→    )
   130→    assert result == {"id": LIST_ROW["id"], "external_ref": NODE, "idempotent": True}
   131→    assert not any(args[0] == "create" for args in calls)
   132→
   133→
   134→def test_create_one_refetches_detail_because_list_rows_omit_type_and_parent(module, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
   135→    """list 行は issue_type/parent を持たないため show 再取得が必須。省くと不整合が素通りする。"""
   136→    def run(detail):
   137→        wire(module, monkeypatch, search=BD_110_SEARCH_HELP, listed=[LIST_ROW], detail=detail)
   138→        return module._create_one(
   139→            tmp_path, graph_node_id=NODE, title="projected", description="body",
   140→            issue_type="task", parent="HarnessHub-EPIC", source_digest=DIGEST,
   141→        )
   142→
   143→    with pytest.raises(module.ContractError, match="has type epic, expected task"):
   144→        run({**LIST_ROW, "issue_type": "epic", "parent": "HarnessHub-EPIC"})
   145→    with pytest.raises(module.ContractError, match="belongs to a different epic"):
   146→        run({**LIST_ROW, "issue_type": "task", "parent": "HarnessHub-OTHER"})
   147→

   150→    """digest が変われば list 経由で見つけた既存を update で差し替える (再 create しない)。"""
   151→    detail = {
   152→        **LIST_ROW,
   153→        "issue_type": "task",
   154→        "parent": "HarnessHub-EPIC",
   155→        "metadata": {"dev_graph_source_digest": "sha256:" + "d" * 64},
   156→    }
   157→    calls = wire(module, monkeypatch, search=BD_110_SEARCH_HELP, listed=[LIST_ROW], detail=detail)
   158→    result = module._create_one(
   159→        tmp_path, graph_node_id=NODE, title="projected", description="body",

   165→    assert update[update.index("--set-metadata") + 1] == f"dev_graph_source_digest={DIGEST}"
   166→
   167→
   168→def test_find_external_fails_closed_on_open_plus_closed_remnant(module, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
